Backend: 45/45 pytest tests pass — 37/37 regression (test_merged_iteration.py: auth, categories, menu items, POS orders, inventory, vendors, expenses, refunds, X/Z reports, dashboard, settings, voice, public, customer auth, online orders, offers, reviews, event-bookings, auth guards) + 8/8 NEW iteration-2 tests (test_iteration2_outsourced.py: 19 admin permissions including the 6 new online_* perms; menu-items expose is_outsourced/outsourced_vendor_id/outsourced_unit_cost; outsourced order auto-creates vendor_transaction and surfaces in /api/vendors/{vid}/sales-summary as auto_billed_from_orders=210 with the product in products[]; refund auto-creates negative reversal with auto_reversed_from_refunds<=-70 and total_billed drops; non-outsourced items create no vendor transactions). Frontend: /admin/sign-in renders UnifiedLoginPage with default-filled admin@restaurant.com/admin123 + data-testid=unified-login-submit; /admin/login and /admin/staff-login both redirect to /admin/sign-in; after login BOTH staff_auth_token and knb_admin_token are set in localStorage; AdminLayout sidebar shows POS Operations FIRST (idx 31) then Online Store (idx 169) with 17 nav items rendered for admin; GlobalOrderAlert pill (data-testid=global-pending-pill) is visible on /admin/pos showing '1 pending' and is correctly HIDDEN on /admin/orders; POSPage sticky checkout — Cash button stays in viewport (y=964, h=36, vh=1080) after adding 8 cart items; ReceiptModal opens after POS order with print-receipt-btn + close-receipt-btn both visible at bottom of dialog; MenuManagement New Item dialog has data-testid=item-outsourced-checkbox; toggling reveals data-testid=item-outsourced-vendor-select and data-testid=item-outsourced-cost-input; AdminOrders auto-refresh — 6 calls to /api/online-orders/pending-count in ~9.5s confirms 4s polling; zero pageerrors across all flows.

ui_bugs.issue: After clicking unified-login-submit with valid admin creds, tokens are correctly stored in localStorage but the page URL did NOT auto-navigate to /admin/pos within 3s wait — it stayed on /admin/sign-in. Manual navigation to /admin/pos works fine because tokens are set. Likely pickLandingRoute() / navigate() race or missing trigger on success state. Low-impact since users can navigate manually and bookmarked redirects work.

action_items: Investigate UnifiedLoginPage post-submit redirect — tokens are set but page stays on /admin/sign-in instead of routing to /admin/pos. Verify pickLandingRoute() returns a valid path and navigate(path, {replace:true}) is called inside the success branch (not behind a guard that re-evaluates before tokens land in localStorage). Acceptance: after submit with admin creds, URL becomes /admin/pos within ~1s.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 3480 lines — still monolithic. Strongly recommend splitting into routers/ (auth, pos, orders_online, vendors_outsourced, reports, refunds, settings, public). Iteration 2 added more endpoints to an already heavy file.

Outsourced reversal in create_refund relies on ObjectId(mid) lookup; if the frontend sends item_id from a non-Mongo source (e.g., uuid) it silently swallows the exception (try/except: pass) and the vendor reversal is skipped without logging. Add structured logging on the failure path so missed reversals are visible.

vendor_sales_summary aggregates by_product but `quantity` is multiplied by sign(amount) which means a refund line subtracts qty correctly only if amount is non-zero. Edge case: a manual zero-total transaction would default to +1. Minor — production flow always has total>0.

Two parallel admin-auth tokens (staff_auth_token + knb_admin_token) are now BOTH set on login. Long-term this duplication should be consolidated to a single source of truth to avoid drift when one is cleared but not the other (e.g. logout).

GlobalOrderAlert polls /api/online-orders/pending-count every 4s on every admin page — combined with AdminOrders' own polling, the orders page makes ~2x requests/sec. Consider lifting the polling state up so AdminOrders subscribes to GlobalOrderAlert's data instead of duplicating fetches.

rca of the issue: Post-login redirect: After submitting unified-login form, both localStorage tokens (staff_auth_token + knb_admin_token) are set and the user object is stored, but the browser URL remains /admin/sign-in instead of routing to /admin/pos within 3s. Reproduction: 1) goto /admin/sign-in, 2) click [data-testid='unified-login-submit'] (defaults pre-filled), 3) wait 3s, 4) read window.location.pathname → '/admin/sign-in' (expected '/admin/pos'). However, manually navigating to /admin/pos afterwards works because tokens are present. Likely cause: in UnifiedLoginPage.jsx the success handler calls pickLandingRoute(user) and navigate(path), but either (a) navigate is called BEFORE setUser/state flush so the route guard in <StaffGate> doesn't see the new auth state and bounces back, or (b) pickLandingRoute returned undefined for the admin role so navigate('') is a no-op. Mitigation: add a small useEffect on user.permissions change that calls navigate(pickLandingRoute(user)) once both tokens are in localStorage; or use window.location.href = path as a hard redirect to bypass the guard race.
